run_diatomic_tests_cli: run the diatomic tests CLI script to compute potential energy curves for diatomic molecules using a pretrained MLIP model
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for a pair of atoms across 100 distances using a predictor model
get_model: load a pretrained machine learning interatomic potential model from a name or path for energy prediction
generate_plot: generate a matplotlib plot of a diatomic potential energy curve and save it as a PNG image file
combined_plot: generate a combined matplotlib plot showing multiple diatomic potential energy curves on a single figure
